post.text:
Rest in peace Jake Larson. Thank you for your service. 

Jake passed away at the age of 102 and the last survivor of D-Day. https://t.co/xEkoyNTjeg
post.author_description: Mandate Freedom! DO NOT COMPLY!! Organizer of The Peoples Convoy.  Anti-Government!

description.description: Each frame depicts a WWII veteran in uniform saluting with a smile. Heavy text overlays indicate a memorial message for the 'Last Survivor of D-Day'. The final frame is a TikTok credit screen.
